==About==

{{i|Crowberry Stalk}} can be found in the wild or Picked from a {{i|Crowberry Bush}}. Learning the [[Flowers & Berries]] Skill will allow you to Pick more Crowberry Stalk from each [[Bush]]. A Crowberry Stalk can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
